senses.definition: a small hole or loop (as in a needle)
examples: the thread wouldn't go through the eye

senses.definition: an area that is approximately central within some larger region
examples: it is in the center of town
they ran forward into the heart of the struggle
they were in the eye of the storm
he tried to catch her eye

senses.definition: good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
examples: she has an eye for fresh talent

senses.definition: the arch of hair above each eye
any of the short curved hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids
either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye
examples: his lids would stay open no longer

senses.definition: normal use of the faculty of vision
